All 6 pages fetched live, HTTP 200, 21-87 KB. That returns raw HTML, and the tier data was parsed from the embedded WH.markup [tier-list=rows] block (tier-label + spec-badge slugs) rather than the ordered-list prose — a stricter, machine-readable form that sidesteps the hyphenated "(S-Tier)" hazard entirely. 80 assignments (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched, 0 missing; the M+ DPS page's A+ band is present and correct.
